quote: Specifically, participants were recruited to complete their writing tasks under one of the three writing modes: (a) Independent, where participants completed the writing task on their own without receiving any assistance from ChatGPT; (b) AI editing, where participants took the primary responsibility of drafting the article while they received only text editing and polishing assistance from ChatGPT; and (c) AI (content) generation, where ChatGPT took the primary responsibility of drafting the initial version of the article while participants provided feedback and directed the subsequent revisions...

In Phase 1, participants were asked to write a 200-250 word article within 45 minutes... we asked our participants to work on one of the two types of writing tasks: • Argumentative essay writing... • Creative story writing...

quote: in Phase 2, we designed a randomized experiment in which participants were recruited to review writing samples collected from Phase 1 on various aspects (e.g., overall quality, organization, creativity).

Participants were each asked to review a random set of six articles... they first evaluated its overall quality on a scale from 1 to 5 stars... they then provided their detailed evaluation of this article on five specific aspects, including the article's (a) grammar and vocabulary, (b) organization, (c) originality, (d) creativity, and (e) emotional authenticity.
